name: Pyramids Apt. 3
headline: Jacuzzi Studio By The Historic Pyramids (Apt.3)
summary: Welcome to one of the most iconic stays in Giza, with unmatched views of the Pyramids. Enjoy the breathtaking sight of all three pyramids from anywhere inside this modern oriental studio, or while relaxing in your private in-room jacuzzi.

description.Space:
This bright and cozy studio is designed for relaxation and comfort  the perfect retreat after a day spent exploring the pyramids and the vibrant streets of Giza.
Inside, you’ll find:

✔️ A private indoor jacuzzi, thoroughly cleaned and sanitized before every stay
✔️ One queen-sized bed with hotel-quality Egyptian cotton linens
✔️ A bathroom stocked with fresh face and body towels
✔️ A compact kitchenette for light meal preparation
✔️ Free Wi-Fi, Cable TV, and Chromecast
✔️ A Nespresso machine
✔️ Complimentary bottled water and two coffee capsules
description.Access:
✔️Guests will have full private access to the Apartment and all of its amenities during their stay.
✔️For larger groups or multiple bookings, feel free to contact us — we may have additional units available in the same building or nearby.
description.Interaction:
✔️We’re available to assist you between 9:00 AM and 4:00 AM Cairo time.
✔️Whether you have questions before arrival or need help during your stay, our team is happy to support you via Airbnb messages throughout your experience.
description.Neighborhood:
⚠️Please note that occasional water or electricity outages may also occur due to local infrastructure maintenance. These are usually resolved quickly, we appreciate your understanding.

✔️ Safety & Accessibility
Despite the humble setting, the area is generally safe and the location provides unbeatable access to the Giza Pyramids.
✔️ Authentic Local Surroundings
The apartment is well-maintained and just as shown in the photos, but the neighborhood offers a modest, authentic experience. Streets may be dusty, unpaved, or littered, common in areas around the Pyramids. If you’re seeking polished or luxury surroundings outside the apartment, this may not be the right fit.
description.Transit:
✔️ Location: Just a short walk to the Giza Pyramids main gate, perfect for sightseeing.
✔️ Transportation: Uber, In-drive, and local taxis are easily available 24/7.
✔️ Private Services:
We offer convenient airport pickup, drop-off, and private guided tours across Cairo and Giza. Just message us to arrange in advance.

⚠️ Parking is not provided. Guests may use nearby street or private parking (subject to availability).
description.Notes:
⚠️ Electricity or water outages may occasionally occur due to infrastructure maintenance in the area. While this is beyond our control, we’ll do our best to assist you if it affects your stay.

✔️The rooftop is part of the building but not managed or maintained by us. We are not responsible for its access, safety, or cleanliness.
✔️We kindly ask that you treat the space with care and leave it tidy at check-out.

We arrived at 1:30pm and check in was at 2pm. We were happy to wait but it wasn’t ready until 2:30pm - we’re pretty patient people so it wasn’t that much of a big deal that check in was late.  However, when we got to our room, the smell was almost unbearable. It was the strongest, weirdest chemical smell that completely stank and you can’t open the windows either so you just have to endure this for the entirety of our 3 days stay.  Overwhelmed by the smell, we were then told that the lock on our door was also broken - they told us to wait and leave the door open so they could fix it. This was good and bad - good so we could potentially air out the stench and bad because 4 stray cats ran into the room and started crawling all over the surfaces and on the bed. They refused to leave and would push the door open and run in again.   They were cute but you just don’t know if these cats have diseases etc. and they’ve been running around outside so it’s not great that they then start walking all over the bed.  The whole lock was replaced eventually after waiting another 45 minutes.  We really expected this all to be ready at the check in time stated and given how long this all took, we expected the apartment to be sparkling. 

The cleanliness of the apartment is really something that needs severe improvement. I’m not too sure what they did to clean it other than pour chemicals on the floor. The bed rails were really dusty. There was rubbish under the bed.  The fridge handles and door were grimy. The remote controls and air con remote had thick dust in between the buttons. The bottles of soap etc were crusty.  We ended up going to the supermarket to buy antibacterial wipes, sponges and washing up liquid.  The sponge left for us in the sink had black stains so obviously it wasn’t new. Everything just felt dirty and stinky.  The hot tub had bits and grime in it too.

We personally wouldn’t stay here again unfortunately. As gorgeous as the view is (which is the only reason why this place gets stars), the cleanliness was just far too much of an issue for us.  The TV didn’t seem to work (turned it on and it was like a computer desktop background?) but that didn’t matter as we were out during the days anyway.  The lift also broke down one morning so we took the stairs down (we were on the 9th floor). Not an issue really but some floors aren’t well lit, there was cat poo on some of the stairs and parts of the building’s walls have been knocked down so it’s exposed to the outside.  The building itself is run down for what is stated a “new build” in the description.  Next time, we would’ve booked a hotel instead for the same amount of money given this place is costly for what it is.

5/5 for host’s responsiveness but if I could give the actual room a negative rating, I would - this Airbnb deserves a -5/5 at best in my books. In all my travels to date, I have NEVER seen anything as atrocious and revolting as this building / room, and I’ve been to almost 70 countries by the time I was in Cairo, and have been to a handful of third world countries and stayed at a lot of extremely affordable hostels / bare bone bnbs / camped out in bare minimum conditions so I dare say I’ve seen my fair share of poverty. I try to be understanding of different living conditions, but the price point at which this is listed in Egypt, it’s a shame Airbnb even has this as a listing because it’s false advertisement and absolutely disgusting.

The room had a spectacular view but there is ABSOLUTELY NOTHING beyond that. The building, from the exterior, looks like it’s been bombed or invaded. Once you walk into the building and take the stairs up - there are bare bricks, stray cats, trash piled up on every floor. I don’t even know how to put it into words cos it’s INSANE. The elevator is also covered in god knows what dirt and diseases. Walking up the stairs we almost slipped and fell because there were cats and unidentified animals running around. Getting into the room itself was another not so pleasant surprise - we were greeted with flies, dirty floors, stains on the hot tub, water leaking from the bathroom floor. I don’t think we are asking for much if we wanted to ask for a decently clean room especially given the high rating and the price point of this Airbnb. To be quite honest, the room smelled a little too and that’s probably from the building itself - ewww. Sure, the host provided two bars of chocolate and bottles of water, which were a nice gesture but no, that does not cut it / make up for the atrocity of the building/room. I have videos/photos for proof if anyone needs. Trust me, I wish I were making this up - but l felt like I was in garbage city (look this up) in Cairo walking into the building. Before you ask, yes, we went on a tour of garbage on our own and enjoyed it - because it was an eye opening experience we CHOSE to have/see on our trip to Cairo. I did not want to come home to an Airbnb that’s in a building that looks like the garbage city, especially not an Airbnb that we paid outrageous amount of money by local standards for. That is an absolutely no. 

One redeeming quality was that the hosts were extremely responsive and accommodating. Our AC was not working, the water pressure was barely existence, the door couldn’t be locked from the inside and they got us assistance immediately and agreed to put us in another room in the building with working AC.
